Al-Sardi School

📍 Nuseirat Refugee Camp, Deir al-Balah
School Deir al-Balah Operational Struck Jun 6, 2024 at ~2am; two GBU-39 missiles hit top floor classrooms. 33–35 killed (9 children, 3 women, 21 men), 70+ injured. One victim named was an 8-year-old boy.

UNRWA school in Nuseirat refugee camp, sheltering approximately 6,000 displaced people at time of strike.
